values.note: Water and electric back-in (up to 24 ft) $44 a night; full hookup back-in $54, pull-through $58; electric-only sites 7-8 (up to 20 ft, too short for a 23-ft rig) $37. Weekly and two-week rates; a 6% Town of Carbondale short-term rental tax is added at booking.

values.note: Online through the town's WebReserv portal; reservations for the next season open on a set day in October (2027 season: October 15, 2026, 10 am MST). Two-week maximum, then a week away before re-booking. Changes through the camp host, 970-379-8151; off-season help 970-510-1278. $37 cancellation fee; inside one week, no refund.

booking.source: https://www.carbondalerec.com/gateway/ ('Reservations for the 2027 Season will open October 15, 2026'; 'LENGTH OF STAY: There is a 2-week maximum stay'; cancellation policy) + https://www.webreserv.com/townofcarbondalerecreationdepartmentco, read 2026-10-26

note: Town of Carbondale Recreation Dept park (formerly private, taken over by the town) along the Roaring Fork River. Riverside but no confirmed RV pads at the waterline. No office or store; camp hosts on site. --Claude
summary: Town of Carbondale Gateway page + its WebReserv portal: confirmed 18 RV sites, 50/30/20 amp, season May 1 - Oct 1, online booking, sold nightly (also weekly/2-week, 14-night max). Fees 37-58 -> 44-58: the $37 electric-only sites 7-8 are capped at 20 ft, so the base for a 23-ft rig is the $44 water/electric site (up to 24 ft). Added full water/sewer, max 45 ft, pull-throughs, dump (guests only), url, max stay and booking note. Note: dropped the site/amp/wifi/season/booking/RV Life restatements.
flags: Website field holds two URLs, the first a carbondale.com tourism listing. Replace with the town's own page https://www.carbondalerec.com/gateway/ (booking: https://www.webreserv.com/townofcarbondalerecreationdepartmentco).
Phone: entry has none. Camp host (May-September) 970-379-8151; off-season Carbondale Recreation and Community Center 970-510-1278 (both from the town's page).

Fit: only the water/electric sites 15-19 (up to 24 ft) and the full hookup sites (25-45 ft) take a 23-ft rig; electric-only 7-8 are 20 ft max. The town warns that booking a site smaller than your RV may cost the reservation, so book a 24-ft-plus site.
Waterfront: the town says the park is 'along the Roaring Fork River' (stored riverview, note says no confirmed pads at the waterline). Mild re-audit lead only; no site-level water claim.
